headline: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents.
context: The startup helps developers build AI agents that work over iMessage, SMS/RCS, email, and other messaging platforms. It's a bet that consumers will increasingly use agents instead of downloading apps.
